1951, October 11
The following is a faithful transcription of the photo copy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap ..
St. Felix Monastery R.R.8 Huntington, Indiana
Blessed be God in all His designs. October 11th, Maternity of Mary our Blessed Mother '51
Mr. H. J. Ricard Bay City, Michigan
God bless you Mr. Ricard - you and yours.
I am certainly pleased to see your hope and confidence in the mercy and gracious wisdom of Almighty God in regard to your little Maurice. I had a very dear and amiale brother of that name Maurice Joachim Casey. He was very talented and from earliest childhood seemed to dream of being a priest. When 16 in his 3rd year in the seminary his health failed and he came home - a family disapoint- ment. However, he worked generously in promoting vocations and was extremely pleased to others take his place - especially our 2nd youngest of ten brothers - just now back from the missions in the Philippines with his mission Headquarters in St. Paul, Minn. - Rt. Rev. E'd F. Casey. - Well after 20 years roving when I was ordained and he served at my first Holy Mass, he decided to " ... try it again and after seven years further study was ordained - at 43 instead of 23. Thanks be to God a billion.
So we will hope an for something of a miracle for little Mau- rice. I am going to pray my deceased Rev. Brother Maurice - and especially our Father Stephen Eckert - whose relic I am herewith inclosing to pray for him and if it please God that he be spared - and have a vocation. For Father Stephen especially we a hoping for miracles so as to promote his Cause of beatification first and then his canonization.
Thanking again for your generous favor for the holy missions I be to remain Sincerely yours in Christ.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of: Mrs. H. J. (Bernadine L.) Ricard 2119 Seventh Street Bay City, Michigan 48706
